name: VideoRSI
description: Recursively improves a video SFT data pipeline rather than model weights. Timestamped caption/entity evidence is mined into grounded multiple-choice tasks, structurally validated, refined with hard negatives, and retained with provenance. A bounded Codex controller snapshots every candidate and may update task definitions, prompts, operators, or task-specific pipeline routing under a fixed evaluation policy. The target model is not repeatedly trained during pipeline search. This package contains the portable runtime, controller, tests and task configuration templates; credentials, videos, checkpoints and generated pools remain external.
feedback_signal: Pipeline-search diagnostics collected each iteration: candidate yield, evidence and schema validation, text-only checks, frozen-target difficulty, duplicate rejection, and accepted frontier-and-novel samples under a fixed budget. These signals update task definitions, prompts, operators, and routing. The target model is not repeatedly trained during the search, and held-out benchmark labels are never used as the in-loop acceptance rule.
stopping_rule: Fixed budget of five pipeline iterations. No convergence or early-stopping criterion. The final best pipeline synthesises the SFT set; the target model is trained only after pipeline search ends.
